billing_prices_interval_check.name: billing_prices_interval_check
billing_prices_interval_check.value:
(
        ("billing_prices"."billing_type" = 'one_time'
          and "billing_prices"."billing_interval" is null
          and "billing_prices"."interval_count" is null)
        or ("billing_prices"."billing_type" = 'recurring'
          and "billing_prices"."billing_interval" in ('month', 'year')
          and "billing_prices"."interval_count" >= 1)
      )

billing_subscriptions_period_check.name: billing_subscriptions_period_check
billing_subscriptions_period_check.value:
(
        "billing_subscriptions"."current_period_start" is null
        or "billing_subscriptions"."current_period_end" is null
        or "billing_subscriptions"."current_period_end" > "billing_subscriptions"."current_period_start"
      )

entitlement_grants_quantity_check.name: entitlement_grants_quantity_check
entitlement_grants_quantity_check.value:
(
        ("entitlement_grants"."entitlement_type" = 'feature'
          and "entitlement_grants"."granted_quantity" is null
          and "entitlement_grants"."remaining_quantity" is null)
        or ("entitlement_grants"."entitlement_type" in ('consumable', 'limit')
          and "entitlement_grants"."granted_quantity" >= 0
          and "entitlement_grants"."remaining_quantity" >= 0
          and "entitlement_grants"."remaining_quantity" <= "entitlement_grants"."granted_quantity")
      )

entitlement_transactions_quantity_sign_c.name: entitlement_transactions_quantity_sign_check
entitlement_transactions_quantity_sign_c.value:
(
        ("entitlement_transactions"."transaction_type" in ('grant', 'refund') and "entitlement_transactions"."quantity" > 0)
        or ("entitlement_transactions"."transaction_type" in ('consume', 'expire', 'revoke')
          and "entitlement_transactions"."quantity" < 0)
        or ("entitlement_transactions"."transaction_type" = 'adjustment' and "entitlement_transactions"."quantity" != 0)
      )

product_entitlements_quantity_check.name: product_entitlements_quantity_check
product_entitlements_quantity_check.value:
(
        ("product_entitlements"."entitlement_type" = 'feature' and "product_entitlements"."quantity" is null)
        or ("product_entitlements"."entitlement_type" in ('consumable', 'limit')
          and "product_entitlements"."quantity" > 0)
      )

product_entitlements_pattern_check.name: product_entitlements_pattern_check
product_entitlements_pattern_check.value:
(
        ("product_entitlements"."grant_cadence" = 'purchase'
          and "product_entitlements"."expiration_policy" = 'fixed_duration'
          and "product_entitlements"."duration_days" > 0)
        or ("product_entitlements"."grant_cadence" = 'monthly'
          and "product_entitlements"."expiration_policy" = 'grant_period_end'
          and "product_entitlements"."duration_days" is null)
        or ("product_entitlements"."grant_cadence" = 'subscription'
          and "product_entitlements"."expiration_policy" = 'subscription_end'
          and "product_entitlements"."duration_days" is null)
      )

video_attempts_request_id_check.name: video_attempts_request_id_check
video_attempts_request_id_check.value:
(
        ("video_attempts"."acceptance_status" = 'accepted' and "video_attempts"."provider_request_id" is not null)
        or ("video_attempts"."acceptance_status" in ('not_submitted', 'rejected', 'unknown') and "video_attempts"."provider_request_id" is null)
      )

video_attempts_lease_check.name: video_attempts_lease_check
video_attempts_lease_check.value:
(
        ("video_attempts"."lease_owner" is null and "video_attempts"."lease_token" is null and "video_attempts"."lease_until" is null)
        or ("video_attempts"."lease_owner" is not null and "video_attempts"."lease_token" is not null and "video_attempts"."lease_until" is not null)
      )

video_generations_mode_assets_check.name: video_generations_mode_assets_check
video_generations_mode_assets_check.value:
(
        ("video_generations"."mode" = 'text-to-video' and "video_generations"."image_asset_id" is null and "video_generations"."reference_video_asset_id" is null)
        or ("video_generations"."mode" = 'image-to-video' and "video_generations"."image_asset_id" is not null and "video_generations"."reference_video_asset_id" is null)
        or ("video_generations"."mode" = 'reference-to-video' and "video_generations"."image_asset_id" is not null and "video_generations"."reference_video_asset_id" is not null)
      )

video_generations_terminal_check.name: video_generations_terminal_check
video_generations_terminal_check.value:
(
        ("video_generations"."status" in ('succeeded', 'failed') and "video_generations"."terminal_at" is not null)
        or ("video_generations"."status" not in ('succeeded', 'failed') and "video_generations"."terminal_at" is null)
      )

video_generations_error_check.name: video_generations_error_check
video_generations_error_check.value:
(
        ("video_generations"."status" in ('failed', 'needs_review') and "video_generations"."error_code" is not null and "video_generations"."error_at" is not null)
        or ("video_generations"."status" not in ('failed', 'needs_review') and "video_generations"."error_code" is null and "video_generations"."error_at" is null)
      )

video_outbox_lease_check.name: video_outbox_lease_check
video_outbox_lease_check.value:
(
        ("video_outbox"."delivery_status" = 'leased' and "video_outbox"."lease_owner" is not null and "video_outbox"."lease_token" is not null and "video_outbox"."lease_until" is not null)
        or ("video_outbox"."delivery_status" != 'leased' and "video_outbox"."lease_owner" is null and "video_outbox"."lease_token" is null and "video_outbox"."lease_until" is null)
      )

video_outbox_delivered_check.name: video_outbox_delivered_check
video_outbox_delivered_check.value:
(
        ("video_outbox"."delivery_status" = 'delivered' and "video_outbox"."delivered_at" is not null)
        or ("video_outbox"."delivery_status" != 'delivered' and "video_outbox"."delivered_at" is null)
      )

video_provider_costs_amount_check.name: video_provider_costs_amount_check
video_provider_costs_amount_check.value:
case
        when "video_provider_costs"."cost_kind" = 'unknown'
          then "video_provider_costs"."amount_micros" is null
           and "video_provider_costs"."currency" is null
        when "video_provider_costs"."cost_kind" in ('estimated', 'actual')
          then "video_provider_costs"."amount_micros" is not null
           and typeof("video_provider_costs"."amount_micros") = 'integer'
           and "video_provider_costs"."amount_micros" >= 0
           and "video_provider_costs"."currency" is not null
           and "video_provider_costs"."currency" glob '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]'
        else 0
      end
